The '''Medal of Conquest''' was a medal awarded to [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jicoln Cadera]] at some point during his life before he went into exile on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] following the [[Crusader's schism]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Cadera used the medal and his other trophies to lure out the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] that was pursuing him to claim a [[Blacklist]] bounty put on his head.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Medal of Conquest appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />
